name: repo-decisions
description: Automatically inject and manage repository ADR decisions for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Keep accepted ADR decisions visible to Codex.
interface.longDescription: Repo Decisions reads repository ADR markdown files, injects active accepted decisions through a UserPromptSubmit hook, exposes tools to locate/list/brief/add/supersede decisions, and keeps a wrapper fallback for deterministic Codex prompt enrichment.
defaultPrompt: Show active ADR decisions for this repo.
Add an ADR for this decision.
